column1: # Lock records, and how each client judges them (#2242 QA-3): one table for
# so they cannot drift. Columns, tab-separated: the lock clients' verdict
# {LIVE} the test's pid, {START} its start time, {BOOT} this boot's id,
# {GONE} a pid that has exited, {NOW} the time now, {NL} a newline. A record's structured
# fields are at its end, after the owner (free text): read from the right.

column3: x pid {LIVE} {NOW} boot={BOOT} start={START} priority=normal beat=1 exclusive=1 ticket=1-0000000000000000001-{LIVE}

rerun pid {LIVE} x pid {GONE} {NOW} boot={BOOT} start=1
